3755-4742-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.

When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.

Repeat.

2060-3634-7889.description:
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.

Resolve the Venser spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

215-3043-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-4885.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

751-3821-5542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
751-3821-5542.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6441-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

240-969-4050-5470.description:

Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

560-2034-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-2034-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-5224-6289-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-4087.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Lavabrink Floodgates and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

2396-6428.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
2396-6428.description:
During the next cleanup step, discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each card discarded this way.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
As you are still in the cleanup step, once the stack is empty and priority has been passed by all players, you will discard down to your maximum hand size again.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2511-2523-5563.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

851-969-2457-4289.description:

Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

64-372-2955.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

457-1409-1770.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
The token copy of Restoration Angel enters, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

439-2511-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.

When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.

Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.

Repeat.
